title: Rational smooth purity naturality and Frobenius mate identification
statement: Fix $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$ in the rational/common-stage coefficient categories of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth separated finite-type morphism of pure relative dimension $d$ between separated finite-type geometric fibers over $k_0$, and let $P_X=Lg_X^*$ and $P_Y=Lg_Y^*$. The canonical smooth purity maps $\gamma_{f,K}:Lf^*K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf^!K$ are natural in every morphism $u:K\to L$ of the rational constructible categories: under the canonical pullback, twist and shift identifications, $$Rf^!(u)\circ\gamma_{f,K}=\gamma_{f,L}\circ(Lf^*u)(d)[2d].$$ For every $K$, the exchange $$e_K:P_XRf^!K\to Rf^!P_YK$$ defined by $$e_K=\gamma_{f,P_YK}\circ b_K\circ(P_X\gamma_{f,K})^{-1}$$, with $b_K:P_X(Lf^*K(d)[2d])\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf^*(P_YK)(d)[2d]$, is the adjunction mate of the inverse compact-support exchange $P_YRf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_!P_X$ under the constructible adjunction $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$. These assertions are identities in the rational category and, for $\Qlb$, in its common-stage category; they quantify over arbitrary rational Weil isomorphisms and do not require a Frobenius-stable integral lattice.
